name: Qwen3-ASR-API
description: Pure OpenAI-compatible Speech-to-Text API powered by Qwen3-ASR via vLLM. State-of-the-art Chinese (22 dialects), English, and 50+ languages. No bloat — just the model and API. Switch between 0.6B (~2-3GB VRAM) and 1.7B (~4-6GB VRAM) via MODEL_ID. CUDA 12.8 (Blackwell/Ada). First start downloads model from HuggingFace. China users: set HF_ENDPOINT to https://hf-mirror.com for faster downloads. Requires NVIDIA GPU with driver 550+.

paths.name: Model Cache
paths.description: Model download cache. Persists across container recreates (~1-3GB).

ports.name: API Port
ports.description: OpenAI-compatible API port. Swagger docs at /docs

variables.name: Model ID
variables.description: Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-0.6B (fast, ~2-3GB VRAM) or Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B (accurate, ~4-6GB VRAM). Restart required after change.

variables.name: HuggingFace Endpoint
variables.description: HuggingFace download endpoint. China users: change to https://hf-mirror.com for faster downloads.

variables.name: GPU Memory Utilization
variables.description: Fraction of GPU memory to allocate (0.0-1.0). Lower if sharing GPU with other containers.

variables.name: Max Model Length
variables.description: Max sequence length for KV cache. 8192 supports ~10min audio. Lower to save VRAM, raise for very long audio.
